input.content:
## What

Large inherited sources now collapse by default, wherever they are declared. The checker's answer is collapsed the same way as the structural one. The Storybook addon now uses that default too, where before it listed everything.

Inventory: every place the collapse decision or its default is made (before this PR):
- Rule: `crates/core/src/resolver/mod.rs` `ResolutionContext::collapses` / `can_collapse`, with `COLLAPSE_THRESHOLD = 30` and `LARGE_API_SOURCE = 200`. Ambient-name clauses are in `resolver/ambient.rs`. Called from `resolver/chain.rs` (interfaces, object-literal aliases). `resolver/alias.rs` sets `expand_all` for `Pick` and `keyof`.
- Core default: `crates/core/src/types/options.rs`, `CollapseInheritedProps::Dependencies` is `#[default]`.
- CLI: `crates/cli/src/main.rs` `--collapse-inherited-props` (extract/check/watch/inspect) and `crates/cli/src/config.rs` (`collapseInheritedProps` key, parse error at :76). There is no CLI default of its own; the core default applies. Help text is in `crates/cli/tests/cmd/extract_help.trycmd`.
- NAPI: `crates/binding/src/lib.rs` (option, parse, doc) and the generated `packages/napi/binding.d.ts`.
- Vite plugin: `packages/vite-plugin/src/options.ts` passes the option through and uses the core default.
- Storybook addon: `packages/storybook/src/provider.ts` (`?? 'none'`, the only non-default choice), `src/index.ts` (option doc), `src/options.ts`, `src/option-keys.ts`, `README.md` options table, and the tests `tests/unit/{provider,preset,session}.test.ts`.
- Checker lane: no collapse decision. `crates/core/src/types/semantic.rs` `apply_props` (whole-project merge) and `pipeline/semantic_hook.rs` `apply` (session merge) dropped only `@types/react` props when the entry had a layer. Every other checker prop was listed, including props of sources the structural answer had collapsed.
- Scripts: `scripts/weekly.py` passed `--collapse-inherited-props none` four times (timed run, RDT-format run, `caliper_layer_members`, oracle extract), with `scripts/test_weekly.py`. `scripts/bench.py` also passes `none` (not changed, see Not verified).
- Docs: `README.md`, `docs/architecture/resolver-type-resolution.md` (Collapse), `docs/measurement.md`, `docs/rdt-differences.md`, `docs/gate-measurements.md`, `docs/storybook-parity.md`, `docs/performance.md`, ARCHITECTURE.md. The last five record historical runs and are left as they are.
- Oracle (`apps/oracle/src/tool-universe.ts`, `construct-checker-run.ts`) and the examples/harnesses (`lazy_bench.rs`, `gate_harness.rs`) pass their own explicit values and are not changed.

## Behaviour change

The rule now lives in one place, `CollapseInheritedProps::collapses(dependency, file, type_name, declared)` in `types/options.rs`. Both lanes use it. A component's own props type (depth 0) is never collapsed.
- `dependencies` (the default everywhere now):
  - A dependency source collapses when it is ambient (DOM/ARIA/style clauses, unchanged) and has more than 30 props.
  - Any other dependency source collapses when it has more than 200 props (unchanged).
  - **New:** a project source (outside `node_modules`) collapses when it has more than 200 props. Only the member count is checked, never the name. Chakra's own `SystemProperties` (705) now collapses like the installed one.
  - Files in `node_modules` that are not a loaded dependency (`@types/react`, lib) never collapse.
  - `can_collapse` is now true in this mode even when no dependency is loaded.
- `all` and `none` behave as before. `none` still expands everything.
- Checker lane (`types::semantic::layer_checker_props`, used by both merges):
  1. If a collapsed structural layer names a checker prop, that prop is left to the layer. The exception is a prop the structural answer itself lists, such as one the component redeclares.
  2. Checker props are grouped by `parent`. Some sources were not resolved by the structural answer: no structural prop and no layer has them as source. Such a source becomes a layer (`members`, `totalProps` = its props in the answer) when the same rule collapses it. A file in `node_modules` counts as a dependency.
  - `@types/react` props are left to `htmlAttributes`, as before. Notable names stay listed as props, whereas the structural lane puts them in `notableInherited`.
  - Ambient recognition is unchanged: `@types/react`, react-aria's `dom.d.ts` and DOM type families. No new name list was added.
- Moved: `resolver/ambient.rs` to `types/ambient.rs`, because `types` may not import `resolver` (architecture test). `in_node_modules` moved to `types/options.rs` and is re-exported from `dependency_types`.
- The addon now defaults `collapseInheritedProps` to `'dependencies'`. The weekly drops its `none` flags so it follows the addon. `caliper_layer_members` now sees members: under `none` it returned nothing.
- Converter untouched: the PR 468 size budget is not included.

## Evidence

Gates (exit codes): `just lint doc-check machete typos` 0. `cargo nextest run -p caliper-docgen-core -p caliper-docgen-semantic -p caliper-docgen` 0 (1472 passed). `just test-checker-lane` 0. `python3 -m unittest scripts/test_weekly.py` 0 (35). Vitest `packages/storybook` provider/preset/session unit tests 0 (75). No snapshot or golden changed. The trycmd help text was regenerated.

New tests. All fail on origin/main: the checker-lane ones do not compile there (`merge_semantic_collapsing` is new), and the others fail on their assertions.
- `by_default_a_project_source_past_the_large_source_threshold_collapses_to_a_layer` (201 props, layer `System`, `totalProps` 201).
- `a_project_source_under_the_large_source_threshold_stays_expanded_and_none_expands_any` (200 props stay listed; `none` lists 201).
- `the_checker_lane_leaves_a_structurally_collapsed_layers_props_to_the_layer` (60 `GlobalDOMEvents` handlers).
- `the_checker_lane_layers_a_large_dependency_dom_source_the_structural_answer_did_not_follow` (same shape; `none` lists all).
- `the_checker_lane_layers_a_project_source_only_past_the_large_source_threshold` (201 vs 200).
- `the_checker_lane_keeps_a_source_the_structural_answer_listed`.
- Addon default: `provider.test.ts` now expects `'dependencies'` (on main it gets `'none'`).

Measurements. Checker on, `extract --json --quiet --no-cache`, run one at a time under a 14 GB RSS watchdog; nothing was killed.
- Base binary: origin/main 7b8f6d0d (`release-candidate-target`). "Base default" is the old CLI default; "base none" is the old addon configuration.
- After: this branch. The CLI default and the addon configuration are now the same flags.
- Props listed are counted per component through `propSets`; layered = total `members` across layers.
- Chakra corpus (`packages/react/src`): base not run (the unfixed 0.11.0 build uses 42 GB). After was measured with this branch plus `origin/fix/bound-converted-type-size` (PR 468) merged locally, uncommitted. Results: 49.5 MB JSON, 629 components, median 139 / max 429 props listed, 406,767 layered members, peak 6,180 MiB.
- **Chakra `Button` argTypes: about 1,141 before (live demo), 146 after.** Counted as rdt props minus React `Attributes`/`RefAttributes`/`ClassAttributes` from node_modules, which is what `toArgTypes` keeps; `extractArgTypes` maps the rest one to one. Most of the remaining median is `Conditions` (130 props). It is not ambient by name and is under 200, so it is listed.
- chakra-only:
  - JSON: 6.26 MB (base default) / 6.27 MB (base none) → 2.43 MB
  - Props listed: median 845, max 900 → median 139, max 194
  - Layered members: 40,943 → 429,164
  - Peak: 627 → 613 MiB
- gate-large:
  - JSON: 8.75 MB → 4.94 MB
  - Props listed: median 845, max 900 → median 139, max 338
- shadcn-ui:
  - JSON: 6.15 MB (base none 6.25) → 5.53 MB
  - Props listed: median 2, max 500 both before and after
  - Total props listed: 39,334 (none 39,747) → 33,163
  - 97 components changed: the checker's DOM handlers are now left to their layers.
- react-spectrum (13.45 MB), mantine core (57.19 MB), ant-design (4.64 MB): byte-identical to base, parsed JSON with `stats` dropped. Base default and base none were already identical there, so their addon output is unchanged too.
- Changed and why: chakra-only and gate-large changed in 608 components each. Chakra's `SystemProperties` (in `node_modules`, 705 props) was already a structural layer, but the checker listed its props; they are now left to the layer. shadcn changed as described above. The Chakra corpus changes through the new project-source rule.

## Not verified

- The addon's session path (`OnDemand` + `semantic_hook`) was not measured. Corpus numbers come from `extract`. The session merge calls the same `layer_checker_props` but was only exercised by unit tests.
- react-spectrum's ~100 checker-only props per component (census) did not change. Their sources are resolved structurally or stay under the rule, and I did not investigate per component. The census mismatch for Spectrum is not closed by this slice.
- In the checker lane a source's size is the number of its props in the answer (after `Omit`), not its declared count. A source near a threshold can therefore decide differently from the structural lane. Notable props in a checker-made layer stay in `props`, not `notableInherited`.
- `scripts/bench.py` still passes `--collapse-inherited-props none`. It is a timing bench, not the addon's configuration, and was left alone.
- The Chakra corpus "before" was not run, by instruction. `just semver` and the TS/napi/integration suites were not run (CI runs them).

- Core default: `crates/core/src/types/options.rs`, `CollapseInheritedProps::Dependencies` is `#[default]`.
- CLI: `crates/cli/src/main.rs` `--collapse-inherited-props` (extract/check/watch/inspect) and `crates/cli/src/config.rs` (`collapseInheritedProps` key, parse error at :76). There is no CLI default of its own; the core default applies. Help text is in `crates/cli/tests/cmd/extract_help.trycmd`.
- NAPI: `crates/binding/src/lib.rs` (option, parse, doc) and the generated `packages/napi/binding.d.ts`.
- Vite plugin: `packages/vite-plugin/src/options.ts` passes the option through and uses the core default.
- Storybook addon: `packages/storybook/src/provider.ts` (`?? 'none'`, the only non-default choice), `src/index.ts` (option doc), `src/options.ts`, `src/option-keys.ts`, `README.md` options table, and the tests `tests/unit/{provider,preset,session}.test.ts`.
- Checker lane: no collapse decision. `crates/core/src/types/semantic.rs` `apply_props` (whole-project merge) and `pipeline/semantic_hook.rs` `apply` (session merge) dropped only `@types/react` props when the entry had a layer. Every other checker prop was listed, including props of sources the structural answer had collapsed.
- Scripts: `scripts/weekly.py` passed `--collapse-inherited-props none` four times (timed run, RDT-format run, `caliper_layer_members`, oracle extract), with `scripts/test_weekly.py`. `scripts/bench.py` also passes `none` (not changed, see Not verified).
- Docs: `README.md`, `docs/architecture/resolver-type-resolution.md` (Collapse), `docs/measurement.md`, `docs/rdt-differences.md`, `docs/gate-measurements.md`, `docs/storybook-parity.md`, `docs/performance.md`, ARCHITECTURE.md. The last five record historical runs and are left as they are.
- Oracle (`apps/oracle/src/tool-universe.ts`, `construct-checker-run.ts`) and the examples/harnesses (`lazy_bench.rs`, `gate_harness.rs`) pass their own explicit values and are not changed.

The rule now lives in one place, `CollapseInheritedProps::collapses(dependency, file, type_name, declared)` in `types/options.rs`. Both lanes use it. A component's own props type (depth 0) is never collapsed.
- `dependencies` (the default everywhere now):

  - Any other dependency source collapses when it has more than 200 props (unchanged).
  - **New:** a project source (outside `node_modules`) collapses when it has more than 200 props. Only the member count is checked, never the name. Chakra's own `SystemProperties` (705) now collapses like the installed one.
  - Files in `node_modules` that are not a loaded dependency (`@types/react`, lib) never collapse.
  - `can_collapse` is now true in this mode even when no dependency is loaded.
- `all` and `none` behave as before. `none` still expands everything.
- Checker lane (`types::semantic::layer_checker_props`, used by both merges):
  1. If a collapsed structural layer names a checker prop, that prop is left to the layer. The exception is a prop the structural answer itself lists, such as one the component redeclares.
  2. Checker props are grouped by `parent`. Some sources were not resolved by the structural answer: no structural prop and no layer has them as source. Such a source becomes a layer (`members`, `totalProps` = its props in the answer) when the same rule collapses it. A file in `node_modules` counts as a dependency.

- The addon now defaults `collapseInheritedProps` to `'dependencies'`. The weekly drops its `none` flags so it follows the addon. `caliper_layer_members` now sees members: under `none` it returned nothing.
